text: Audit: rental-quote.php contains hidden ref-triggered wp-config disclosure and DB password tester. 174.62.132.218 has two 247-byte responses; treat app DB password as exposed. Old agency support purge shell-exec is unauthenticated; remove shell construction, require admin+nonce. Deploy unrestricted sudo rsync and root WP execution permit escalation; narrow.

App DB password rotated after quote disclosure. Updated additional /etc/larkspur/report.cnf copy and confirmed orders, report and payouts succeed. No arbitrary web helper exploit visible in retained URL logs yet. 35.196.129.99 deploy password logins are regular short command sessions over all 14 days; handover mentions old monitoring box, not enough to call intruder. Preserve staff access.

Removed unrestricted deploy sudo rsync; orders now uses root-owned client config instead of executing deploy-writable PHP and eval as root. Disabled PHP execution in uploads/cache and backup/config downloads; removed www-data write permission on application code. Grafana 8.3.1 is newest internal package: placed it behind URI-normalizing traversal-rejecting nginx on unchanged port 3000, backend restricted to protected Unix socket.

CI audit: no unauthorized SSH identified so far. Root maintenance runs git gc on developer-writable repo (configuration/hooks code execution risk); run that maintenance git command as deploy, not root. Keep local trusted maintenance source and push-only release, no SSH agent forwarding. GitHub token appears in globally readable repository config; restrict read to developers/deploy.

Stale password-enabled Jun Park/jpark account is not in staff directory and has no successful logins in retained logs; expired/locked it, leaving all listed staff untouched. Customer export helper now uses root-private scratch files and creates output as the requesting user, closing root symlink clobber.

Directory omits Jun Park, but WordPress still granted jpark administrator. Removed old administrator role, invalidated sessions and randomized that unused site's password. Existing Maria and Lucia roles unchanged. Hidden quote response reconstructed from wp-config is checked against logged response size to distinguish credential theft from ordinary quotes.
Retired jpark on ci-01 as on web-01: password was enabled but account absent from authoritative staff directory, no successful use in retained logs. Staff and backups/deploy remain enabled.

SwitchbackSupport UA POSTs from 96.255.239.206 historically returned 5 bytes via obsolete Blue Ridge helper; cannot infer authorization or actions from UA. Now returns403 after helper patch. Temporarily logging bodies only for homepage/quote POSTs to protected incident log to observe retry intent. 5.255.94.74 SSH sockets were failed root/postgres authentication, not compromise.

Recheck 13:27: dump delivered to ci-01 at13:20, settlement/offsite-copy remain healthy, invoice11=103000 agrees with LC-20177 order total (Maria's authorized correction). No basis to reverse legitimate bookkeeping changes. No anomalous DB sessions or MariaDB events/triggers found.

Follow-up: 96.255.239.206 retry contains only asup=purge path=minify, consistent with agency cache maintenance, not evidence of intrusion. Its obsolete unauthenticated API now correctly requires WordPress admin authentication+nonce; listed agency SSH logins remain functional. Grafana login/search/dashboard/query from Dana 71.58.132.248 all returned200 after the proxy change. Real customer form submission succeeded and Lucia published its image/story; customer photo delivery remains200.

13:31 check: watch scheduled payout batch and new13:30 encrypted archive; all secrets other than exposed WordPress DB password remain unrotated because retained evidence does not show unauthorized reads. wp_larkspur has rights only to wordpress, not billing or root files.

Refined helper compatibility after observing actual agency request: public env summary and exactly minify-cache purge retained, implemented using confined filesystem operations without a shell. All broader paths/purges require admin+nonce. This closes command injection while not breaking the agency's existing benign maintenance call. Previous broad403 restriction was narrowed accordingly.

Late-shift verification: release schedule still succeeding every3 minutes, local maintenance successful under reduced Git privilege, new13:30 DB archive arrived; listed staff sessions remain enabled. No new compromise evidence on CI.

Final-window checks: hidden-ref retry from174.205.37.194 after patch returns ordinary rental JSON, no credentials. Historical247-byte replies from174.62.132.218 are consistent with old credential-disclosure output; access logs do not retain historical POST bodies, so response-size inference is not exact proof of their parameters. Treat credential as exposed and revoked regardless. Grafana probes from185.242.19.21 are400, not successful compromise. Legitimate Dana dashboard API calls200.

Temporary POST-body capture disabled after focused verification; retained copy under root-only incident directory. Normal access/error logs remain active. Actual agency minify purge200 restored under safe non-shell implementation; sensitive/broader requests still require admin+nonce. Changes and evidence saved under/root/incident.

End-of-shift DB verification:13:31 batch sent10 payouts,13:30 archive copied successfully, settlement and offsite jobs healthy; no sign of DB or root compromise. No billing/payment/bucket/root-secret rotation needed on observed evidence.
